subject.title: feat(googlechat): opt-in dmThreadMode to thread DM replies

question: Should Google Chat DM thread opt-in be a separate `dmThreadMode` account key, fold into the existing `replyToMode` or `threadSessions` direction, or be paused?
rationale: This PR introduces a new user-facing config surface in an area with prior invalid-thread failures and overlapping open thread-session work, so automation should not choose the permanent product API.

options.title: Choose one threading API first
options.body: Require this PR or the overlapping thread-session work to converge on one documented config surface before merge.

options.title: Accept `dmThreadMode` as separate
options.body: Allow the separate DM-only knob, but require the missing exported type, generated metadata, docs, and live proof on this branch.

options.title: Pause DM thread opt-in
options.body: Keep the current post-fix behavior while maintainers decide whether Google Chat DM threading should be supported at all.

recommendation.title: Choose one threading API first
recommendation.body: Require this PR or the overlapping thread-session work to converge on one documented config surface before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and verified the prior DM thread-suppression fix and have adjacent Google Chat thread-reply history.
